auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.BRAILLE_FORM_BINDING: Binds an exact canonical Braille form to a semantic source path.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.DEPENDENCY_EDGE: Preserves a rule, source-section, or phase reference required by the canonical semantics.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.PROFILE_OR_MODE_POLICY: Preserves behavior that varies across Basis-, Voll-, or Kurzschrift profiles.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.EXCEPTION_CONSTRAINT: Preserves an explicit exclusion or exception to the dominant behavior.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.TRANSPORT_BLANK_SEMANTICS: Preserves Computerbraille transport-blank semantics distinct from semantic blanks.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.CHANNEL_POLICY: Preserves coexistence or selection of named semantic channels.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.CONTRACTION_CONSTRAINT: Preserves contraction-specific behavior that cuts across the dominant primitive.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.CONTEXT_PREDICATE: Preserves an explicit predicate that must hold for contextual behavior.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.CASE_DEFAULT_POLICY: Preserves the default case interpretation inside a contextual domain.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.LINE_BREAK_CONSTRAINT: Preserves explicit legal line-break behavior associated with a sign.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.SPACING_CONSTRAINT: Preserves spacing behavior secondary to a non-spacing primary primitive.
auxiliaryFamilyDefinitions.SEMANTIC_SELECTION_REQUIREMENT: Preserves the requirement that print semantics must disambiguate a shared Braille form.
